resources.string: I agree to the privacy policy. Web searches go to the search engine set in the app. Recent searches stay on this phone and are not saved in Private Mode.
Search your media or the web

H Media Player keeps your settings, your recent searches, and what the engine learns about playback on this phone. None of that is uploaded.
The only data that leaves your phone is a web search: the search text goes to the search server the app is set up to use, which removes tracking from result links and does not log what you search. The search provider behind that server receives the search text.
Private Mode stops saving recent searches and clears web cookies and cache when you leave a web page.
The app asks for permission to read the video and audio on your phone so it can find them. It does not upload those files.
This version has no ads and no accounts.
To find the video and music on this phone, allow media access. Web search works without it.
Most web pages need scripts. Turn this off for a safer but plainer web view.
Private Mode is on. Recent searches are hidden and nothing new is saved.
It learns which preset works best on your Wi-Fi and mobile data. Everything stays on this phone and nothing is uploaded.
